items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: That's when Eddie Pearson had the band in the last couple years. ... And after Eddie died one, I didn't stay there long. ... I came in last year in July.

ctx.x: That's when Eddie Pearson had the band in the last couple years.
Yes. Eddie died two years. Eddie had been dead two years now, ain't he?
Not quite. A little over a year, I guess. Over a year, yeah.

items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: I never know him to play any blues out of the D-Range.

ctx.x: Really good. Oh yeah, he was good. And his real blues was Kelly's Love. Yeah. And boy, he was the best band around here on that.
So, did the Eddle play any, do you ever remember him playing any blues out of the D-Range?
No, no. I, no. I never know him to play any blues out of the D-Range.
